figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM old_customers UNION ALL SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM new_customers ORDER BY customer_name;

parts.label: 取数
parts.note: 结果表最终显示 2 列：customer_id、old_customers。

parts.label: 合并
parts.note: 用 UNION ALL 合并前后两个查询的结果。

parts.note: 结果表最终显示 2 列：customer_id、new_customers。
